svg.title: The Three Ways
svg.desc: The Three Ways. DevOps in three principles: speed the flow of work to customers, amplify feedback back to the team, and keep learning. Step 1, Handoffs and big batches: 47 days from idea to customers, 6 of them work. Complaints reach ops 2 weeks later, never the team. Step 2, First Way: flow: Visible work, small slices, automated tests and push-button deploys: gift wrap ships in 4 days. Step 3, Second Way: feedback: A failing test stops the line, and an alert reaches the checkout team 3 minutes after the deploy. Step 4, Third Way: learning: A blameless postmortem and a game day turn INC-3 into a 1 s timeout default for every team.
